long_biography.plain_text:
Daniele Cammarone left his IT project-management work at Warner Village Cinemas to build a mobility-services company in Rome. CammaRent developed an offer of cars and minivans, both self-drive and chauffeured, for travellers and corporate clients. The enterprise later added tailored transport for events and premium travel.

The company also operates a Mediterranean charter division, bringing maritime travel into its wider service portfolio. Separately, Cammarone trained as a coach and began teaching entrepreneurship after his business venture was established. He also completed five marathons within twelve months while learning to speak before classroom audiences.
